visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with an animation-based informational graphic displayed against a bright, soft-focus background of white and light blue textures resembling rippling water or cosmetic serum. A central information table lists several cosmetic ingredients, including Peptides, Vitamin C, Retinol, Salicylic Acid, Hyaluronic Acid, and Niacinamide, each contained within white pill-shaped boxes. Next to each ingredient is a specific timeframe for results and a list of skin benefits in Traditional Chinese text. At the top center, a small blue circular progress bar icon rotates continuously to visualize the concept of time. The lighting is high-key and extremely bright, creating a clean, professional aesthetic. (2) There is a direct cut to a motion graphic brand reveal. The screen background is solid white. Multiple thin, light-grey geometric lines animate from the corners, converging towards the center of the frame. A black brand logo with a stylized monogram 'DRX' fades into the center, accompanied by the text '達特仕保養品' and 'DRX Series Skincare' in a clean, modern sans-serif font. The overall visual style is minimalist and high-contrast.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Variety]: 保養品要多久才能見效呢？ [Slogan]: 胜肽. 6-12週. 修復肌膚、增加彈性. 維他命C. 3-8週. 提亮膚色、抗氧化、淡斑. A醇. 6-12週. 提亮膚色、抗氧化、淡斑. 水楊酸. 幾分鐘-2週. 滲透毛孔、控油、預防粉刺. 玻尿酸. 1-3天. 保濕、鎖水、淡化細紋. 菸鹼醯胺. 4-8週. 提亮膚色、控油、美白. [Logo]: DRX SERIES SKINCARE. 達特仕保養品. (2) [Logo]: DRX Series Skincare. 達特仕保養品.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The first background is a soft, blurry aesthetic representation of water ripples or liquid textures in white and pale blue tones. The second background is a clean, flat white studio-style screen with minimal grey geometric lines.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track opens with a bright, upbeat acoustic-pop background music loop. The arrangement features a high-brightness piano melody playing repetitive arpeggios and chords, supported by a steady, quantized electronic percussion beat at approximately 115 BPM. The mix is clear and well-balanced, with no human speech or ambient interference. (2) A sharp, synthetic 'pop' or digital 'click' sound effect triggers precisely as the visual scene shifts. This short-duration transient effect serves as a rhythmic anchor for the transition. The BGM piano melody continues without interruption. (3) As the brand logo remains on screen, the BGM concludes its current melodic cycle with a final three-note tonic resolution. The percussion stops instantly, and the piano resonance is allowed to decay naturally for a split second before a smooth digital fade-out to total silence.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves an educational and promotional purpose, providing consumers with scientific expectations for how long various skincare ingredients take to show visible results. It establishes brand authority and trust for DRX Series Skincare by presenting factual information in a clean, aesthetically pleasing, and professional graphic format.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video ends with a clear logo reveal and brand name for DRX Series Skincare, with the informative content framed within the brand's graphic identity.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a high-information-density graphic chart to provide educational value, which is a common tactic for skincare brands to build credibility.
